bio:
Bubble Blowers w/ Aux’d Lady

*Bi-monthly*

Aux’d Lady is a traveling producer based on the East coast. She draws inspiration from her favorite Video Game OSTs like The DarkStalkers Collection, the DC Gogo scene, classic jungle tapes, and her favorite Detroit duo, Drexciya. Aux’d Lady often creates tracks and projects based off of her illustrations of the various fantasy worlds she builds in her sketchbook. Her most recent project “That was my Worst Nightmare, Thank you for making it real.” revolves around a young girl’s endless nightmare as it begins to blend into her waking reality. She also enjoys flipping and remixing the hell out of any song that catches her ear. Especially if it won’t stop playing in her mind. In her home studio you can find her circuit bending old toys, modding synths, and creating unconventional instruments just to keep herself interested. Aux’d Lady is currently working on a new project set to be released sometime in 2027.
title: Aux’d Lady
